observations: Photo 0 shows the retail packaging for an SKE Mini UPS.
The brand 'SKE' and model 'POE-830P-LFP' are clearly printed on the box.
The box lists specifications: 20000mAh capacity, 24V POE port, 9V/12V selectable DC port, and 5V USB/Type-C ports.
The actual device is not visible; only the box is shown.
There are multiple identical boxes in the background, suggesting commercial stock.
A watermark 'ORIJO INTEGRITY COMMERCE' is present on the image.

Photo of the label on the back of the actual unit.
